description: This Java class defines a custom UI layout component for Wear OS devices, representing a single item in a speed picker list. It extends LinearLayout and implements WearableListView.OnCenterProximityListener to animate and style the item based on its position (centered or not).
external_files: R.java (resources, e.g., R.integer.action_text_faded_alpha, R.color.grey, R.color.blue, R.id.circle, R.id.name)

classes.name: SpeedPickerLayout
classes.description: Custom LinearLayout for displaying a speed option in a Wear OS list, with behavior to change appearance based on its proximity to the center.

methods.name: SpeedPickerLayout
methods.description: Constructs the layout with context, attribute set and style, initializing appearance parameters.

methods.name: onFinishInflate
methods.description: Initializes references to child views (circle image and name text) after inflation.

methods.name: onCenterPosition
methods.description: Updates the style when this item is centered in the list (highlights the circle and makes text fully opaque).

methods.name: onNonCenterPosition
methods.description: Updates the style when this item is not centered (fades text and changes circle color to gray).
